en: The model service is not responding or the connection dropped; please try again.
ru: Сервис модели временно не отвечает или соединение прервано; повторите попытку позже.
zh: 模型服务暂时无响应或连接中断，请稍后重试。

en: Output hit the length limit; the answer is not complete.
ru: Достигнут лимит длины вывода; ответ неполный.
zh: 已到达输出长度限制，回答尚未完整。

en: The model request failed and a retry is pending. Details stay in the process.
ru: Запрос к модели не прошёл, ожидается повтор. Подробности остались в процессе.
zh: 模型请求未成功，正在等待重试。详情保留在执行过程中。

en: The command did not run successfully
See the command record in the original chat
ru: Смотреть запись команды в исходной беседе
zh: 查看原对话中的命令记录

en: This record type is not wired into the reading view yet: {kind}
ru: Этот тип записи ещё не поддерживается в режиме чтения: {kind}
zh: 此记录类型暂未接入阅读页：{kind}

en: This session cannot be read right now: {message}
Handle it in the native action area below. This notice stays out of the process fold.
ru: Обработайте это в нативной области действий ниже. Это предупреждение не сворачивается в процесс.
zh: 请在下方原生操作区处理。此提示不会收进执行过程。

en: This content cannot be shown in the reading view; the original chat record is untouched.
ru: Это содержимое нельзя показать в режиме чтения; запись в исходной беседе не затронута.
zh: 此内容暂时无法在阅读页显示；原对话中的记录未受影响。

en: This content type is not wired into the reading view yet; the raw content is kept.
ru: Этот тип содержимого ещё не поддерживается; сырое содержимое сохранено.
zh: 此内容类型尚未接入阅读页，原始内容已保留。

en: Copy failed; please select the text manually
ru: Не удалось скопировать, выделите текст вручную
zh: 未能复制，请手动选择文字

en: Fork a new session from here
zh: 以此处为基础创建分叉会话

en: Fork a new session from here (Fork)
zh: 以此处为基础创建分叉会话 (Fork)

en: The image could not be loaded

zh: 已压缩上下文 · 释放约 {tokens} tokens

en: Compacted {items} context entries · freed about {tokens} tokens
zh: 已压缩 {items} 条上下文 · 释放约 {tokens} tokens

en: Expand to read the digest distilled at this node
ru: Разверните, чтобы прочитать сводку этого узла
zh: 展开查看此节点提炼的记忆摘要

en: Open the whole workspace folder in the file manager
ru: Открыть всю рабочую папку в файловом менеджере
zh: 在访达中打开整个工作区目录
在访达中定位所在目录 ({folder})
在访达中显示所在目录

en: When a new thought starts, fold the earlier steps into one summary line. Turning this off keeps the raw process and streaming output.
ru: Сворачивать предыдущие шаги в одну строку сводки при начале нового размышления. Если выключить, исходный процесс и потоковый вывод сохраняются.
zh: 新思考产生时，是否自动将此前步骤收拢为一行汇总。关闭后完整保留原始过程与流式输出。

en: History could not be loaded; try again. Nothing already loaded changed.
ru: Не удалось загрузить историю, можно повторить; уже загруженное содержимое не изменилось.
zh: 历史记录加载失败，可再次尝试；现有内容未改变。

en: Input still being generated · not executed · last 12 lines
ru: Ввод ещё формируется · не выполнен · последние 12 строк
zh: 正在生成的输入 · 尚未执行 · 末尾 12 行

en: File content in the tool input
zh: 工具输入中的文件内容

en: · first 1,600 lines previewed, full content in the raw data
ru: · предпросмотр первых 1 600 строк, полное содержимое в сырых данных
zh: · 预览前 1,600 行，完整内容在原始数据中

en: Command still being generated · not executed
zh: 正在生成命令 · 尚未执行

en: Interrupted with no tool result. The generated input is still viewable.
ru: Прервано без результата инструмента. Сформированный ввод доступен.
zh: 已中断，没有工具结果。已生成的输入仍可查看。

en: The model is generating the tool input; the tool has not started.
ru: Модель формирует вход инструмента, инструмент ещё не запущен.
zh: 模型正在生成工具输入，工具还未开始执行。

en: The tool started and is waiting for a result.
zh: 工具已开始执行，正在等待结果。

en: The tool was cancelled and did not finish. Input and raw response are still viewable.
ru: Инструмент отменён без завершения. Ввод и сырой ответ доступны.
zh: 工具已取消，未正常完成。输入和原始返回记录仍可查看。

en: The file tool returned. Below is the submitted content; the full record is under “Raw”.
ru: Файловый инструмент вернул ответ. Ниже отправленное содержимое; полная запись в «Сырых данных».
zh: 文件工具已返回。以下为提交的内容；完整返回记录可在「原始数据」查看。

en: The code ran with no output to show.
ru: Код выполнен, вывод показывать не нужно.
zh: 代码已执行，没有可展示的输出。

en: Images and extended content are shown separately in the chat.
ru: Изображения и расширенный контент показаны отдельно в беседе.
zh: 图片或扩展内容已在对话中单独展示。

ru: Инструмент ничего не вернул для показа.
zh: 工具没有返回可展示的内容。
已停止 · 调用记录保留

en: Deeper nested calls are available in the original chat.
ru: Более вложенные вызовы видны в исходной беседе.
zh: 更深的嵌套调用可在原对话查看。
已提交 · 等待工具返回
已停止 · 输入记录保留

en: Preview updates are paused to keep your selection; see the card title for the current state.
ru: Обновление предпросмотра приостановлено, чтобы сохранить выделение; текущее состояние в заголовке карточки.
zh: 为保留选区，预览暂停更新；当前状态见卡片标题。

en: Full record · read-only · code inside is never executed
ru: Полная запись · только чтение · код внутри не выполняется
zh: 完整记录 · 只读 · 不执行其中的代码
步骤 {n} 的思考，可滚动阅读

en: Clear the text selection to keep following
ru: Снимите выделение текста, чтобы продолжить слежение
zh: 取消文字选择后可继续跟随

en: Expand to read the full thinking
This turn stopped; generated content is kept.
zh: 本轮已停止，已生成的内容仍保留。

en: This turn is blocked; check the original chat and the action area below.
ru: Проход требует обработки блокирующих элементов; проверьте исходную беседу и область действий ниже.
zh: 本轮需要处理阻塞事项；请查看原对话与下方操作区。

en: Output reached the per-turn length limit and may be incomplete.
ru: Вывод достиг лимита длины прохода, содержимое может быть неполным.
zh: 输出达到本轮长度限制，内容可能尚未完整。

en: This turn did not finish; the error stays below.
ru: Проход не завершён; сообщение об ошибке осталось ниже.
zh: 本轮未完成；错误信息保留在下方。

en: This turn ended as: {reason}. Check the full record in the original chat.
ru: Состояние завершения прохода: {reason}. Проверьте полную запись в исходной беседе.
zh: 本轮结束状态：{reason}。请在原对话中核对完整记录。
查看本轮 Token 消耗

en: Timing and speed for this turn
Click to load earlier records · this rail covers the {count} loaded turns
ru: Нажмите, чтобы загрузить более ранние записи · эта полоса охватывает только {count} загруженных проходов
zh: 点击加载更早记录 · 当前轨道仅覆盖已加载的 {count} 轮
{label} · 改动 {added} 行，删除 {removed} 行

en: Put this result back into the composer, then press Enter to send
ru: Перенесите этот результат в поле ввода и отправьте Enter
zh: 把这条结果重新填入输入框，然后回车发送
内容过长，已截断（共 {total} 个字符）

en: Your chat model thinks and answers; the vision model reads images. Configure them independently.
zh: 聊天模型负责思考与回答，识图模型负责看图片；两者可以独立设置

en: Chat and image understanding are separate
Your chat model handles reasoning and answers; the vision model reads images. When sending images, choose a model marked “+ Auto Vision” in chat.
zh: 聊天模型负责思考和回答，识图模型负责看图片。发图片时，在聊天页选择带「+ 自动识图」的模型即可。

en: To change only image understanding, edit “Vision model” below. Your current chat model will not change.
zh: 只想更换识图模型？直接修改下面的「识图模型」，不会影响当前聊天模型。

en: For first use, remember one thing: the chat model answers, and the vision model reads images. Follow these 3 steps.
zh: 第一次使用只需要记住：聊天模型负责回答，识图模型负责看图。跟着下面 3 步设置即可。

en: Choose the model you normally use from the lower-right chat selector. For images, choose its “+ Auto Vision” version.
zh: 在聊天页右下角选择你平时使用的模型。需要发图片时，请选择带「+ 自动识图」的版本。

en: Open Settings → Vision Router and choose it under “Vision model”. It only reads images and does not replace your chat model.
zh: 打开「设置 → Vision Router」，在「识图模型」里选择。它只负责读取图片，不会替换你的聊天模型。

en: Add more than one vision model if you want. If one fails, Vision Router tries the next; the built-in free fallback remains available at the end.
zh: 可以添加多个识图模型；前一个不可用时会自动尝试下一个。全部失败后，还可以使用内置免费兜底。
第 1 步 · 选择聊天模型

en: The model selector next to the chat input in the lower-right corner is now highlighted. For image turns, pick a group marked “+ Auto Vision”; the model inside still handles chat, reasoning, and tool calls. Click “Next” when done.
zh: 聊天页右下角、输入框旁的模型选择器已经被高亮。选择你平时使用的聊天模型；发图片时请选择带「+ 自动识图」的版本。选好后点击「下一步」。
第 2 步 · 选择识图模型

en: Click the highlighted settings launcher at the bottom-left of the sidebar. In Desktop it may appear as your account avatar or the More menu. You can also press “Next”.
zh: 点击侧边栏左下角被高亮的设置入口；Desktop 中这里可能显示为账号头像或「更多」。也可以直接点「下一步」继续。

en: In the account menu, click the highlighted “Settings” item (or press “Next” to open Settings automatically).
zh: 在弹出的账号菜单中点击被高亮的「设置」（或点「下一步」自动打开设置面板）。

en: In Settings, click the highlighted “Vision Router” entry (or press “Next”). I will take you directly to “Vision model”.
zh: 在设置面板左侧点击被高亮的「Vision Router」入口（或点「下一步」自动进入）。我会直接定位到「识图模型」。
第 3 步 · 设置备用模型

en: Vision models are tried from top to bottom. You may add several fallbacks or leave them empty; the built-in OVH free model remains the final fallback. Save when done.
zh: 这里的识图模型会从上到下依次尝试。可以添加多个备用模型，也可以全部留空；内置 OVH 免费模型会在最后自动兜底。选好后点击页面底部「保存」。

en: The active settings provider is read-only.
Remote writes are off by default. On the machine running DSH, open the loopback UI and enable “Allow trusted-host remote settings” under Settings → Vision Router → Advanced settings → Network.
zh: 出于安全考虑，远程修改默认关闭。请先在运行 DSH 的机器上通过回环地址打开「设置 → Vision Router → 高级设置 → 网络」，启用「允许可信 Host 远程修改设置」。

en: Vision Router could not reach its scoped remote-settings channel. Update the plugin and make sure this remote address is configured as a DSH trusted host.
zh: 无法连接 Vision Router 的远程设置通道。请确认插件已更新，并且当前远程地址已按 DSH 的方式配置为 trusted host。

en: The Vision Router settings namespace is not ready yet. This page will retry automatically.
zh: Vision Router 设置命名空间尚未就绪，页面会自动重试。

en: The remote-settings route returned 404. If DSH is behind Nginx, Caddy, or another reverse proxy, also forward /vision-router-settings/* to DSH.
zh: 远程设置路由返回 404。若使用 Nginx/Caddy/其他反向代理，请同时转发 /vision-router-settings/* 到 DSH。

en: Remote pages can change low-risk preferences only. Network, credentials, local backends, artifact paths, desktop capture, and host routing remain loopback-only.
zh: 远程页面只允许修改低风险偏好；网络、凭据、本地后端、产物目录、桌面截图和宿主路由等设置只能在 DSH 本机修改。

en: Settings changed on another client. The latest values were refreshed; review your draft and save again.
zh: 设置已被另一端修改。已刷新最新配置，请确认你的修改后重新保存。

en: When on (and at least one local vision backend is enabled), image blocks are recognized locally on the first model step — the model understands the image immediately without calling a vision tool first. If Ollama fails, LM Studio is tried next. Multiple images are recognized concurrently (up to 3 — local inference is VRAM-bound); a failing image is skipped without affecting the rest; total failure falls back to the tool-hint marker. The session log keeps the original image.
zh: 开启后（需同时开启至少一个本地视觉后端），图片轮第一轮直接用本地模型识别图片块；若同时开启「结构化预识别（1+x）」，则由 1+x 首遍识别接管，本开关不会额外再跑一遍；Ollama 失败会继续尝试 LM Studio。一次贴多张图时并发识别（上限 3，本地推理受显存限制），单张失败自动跳过、不影响其余；整体失败则回退为工具提示标记。会话日志仍保留原图。
本地视觉 · Ollama / LM Studio

en: This section only configures Ollama / LM Studio backends. The automatic first visual pass is controlled solely by “Structured pre-scan (1+x)” above; no extra switch is needed.
zh: 这里只配置 Ollama / LM Studio 本地视觉后端；自动首遍识别统一由上方「结构化预识别（1+x）」控制，无需额外开关。
填写 Developer 页或 /v1/models 中的模型标识

en: Enter a real model identifier before enabling LM Studio.
zh: 启用 LM Studio 时必须填写真实模型标识。

en: When enabled, local-ollama heads the vision chain (private / free / offline); when Ollama is down it is skipped automatically and the chain falls through to the cloud. Off by default.
zh: 开启后 local-ollama 排在视觉链最前（隐私 / 零费用 / 离线）；Ollama 未运行时自动跳过并降级到云链，不影响任何调用。默认关闭。
本地 LM Studio 识别
LM Studio 地址（OpenAI 兼容）

en: A local backend on the same level as Ollama: LM Studio's compatible endpoint (default http://localhost:1234/v1). Model must be the real identifier shown in Developer or returned by /v1/models. When enabled, local-lmstudio sits after local-ollama and before the cloud chain; when LM Studio is down it is skipped automatically. Off by default.
zh: 与 Ollama 同层级的本地后端：LM Studio 的兼容端点（默认 http://localhost:1234/v1）。模型名必须填写 Developer 页或 /v1/models 返回的真实模型标识。启用后 local-lmstudio 排在 local-ollama 之后、云链之前；未运行时自动跳过降级。默认关闭。

en: Affects only local recognition output (instant image recognition / screenshot recognition); structured is better for screenshot analysis (GUI / documents / chat logs).
zh: 仅影响本地识别（即时识图 / 截图识图）的输出格式；结构化对截图分析（GUI / 文档 / 聊天记录）质量更高。

en: Each line must be "provider/model", e.g. openrouter/qwen3-vl-235b

The anonymous OVHcloud vision chain contains {count} models, starting with {primary}. Anonymous limits are {perModelRpm} requests/minute per IP per model; {count} independent model buckets are about {totalRpm} RPM in theory, subject to OVH rate limiting. It always runs after your user models and needs no signup or API key.
zh: OVHcloud 匿名视觉链共 {count} 个模型，首选 {primary}。匿名限额为每 IP、每模型 {perModelRpm} 次/分钟；{count} 个模型独立限额，理论合计约 {totalRpm} 次/分钟，实际以 OVH 限流为准。它固定在上面用户模型之后尝试，免注册、免 Key。

en: Choose the models Vision Router uses to read images. They are tried from top to bottom, with automatic failover.
zh: 选择 Vision Router 用来读取图片的模型。将按从上到下的顺序尝试，失败时自动切换到下一个。

en: Usually unnecessary; leave empty to use the default chat model.
zh: 通常无需设置；留空即使用默认聊天模型。

en: These models read images and do not change the chat model selected in the composer. Your models are tried in order; the built-in OVH free model remains the final fallback.
zh: 这里设置负责看图的模型，不会改变聊天页选择的聊天模型。你的模型按顺序尝试；内置 OVH 免费模型固定作为最后兜底。

en: Loading the model catalog (same source as Settings → Models)…
zh: 正在加载模型目录（与「设置 > 模型」同源）…

en: Connection service unavailable (no model catalog); falling back to free-text input.
zh: 连接服务不可用（拿不到模型目录），退回手动输入。
模型目录接口返回失败

en: ); model fields fell back to free-text input.
Some configured providers failed to load their model catalog: {detail}. They may still appear in Settings → Models, but are temporarily unavailable here.
zh: 部分已配置供应商的模型目录加载失败：{detail}。这些供应商可能仍会显示在「设置 → 模型」中，但暂时不会出现在这里。

en: Reading model image-capability metadata (advisory only; it does not hide selectable models)…
zh: 正在读取模型图片能力声明（仅用于提示，不影响可选模型）…

en: Capabilities unavailable; models remain selectable, but image delivery depends on Host input declaration.
zh: 能力数据不可用，仍可选择模型；实际图片投递取决于Host声明及传输支持。

en: Model capability labels do not restrict selection; a Host text-only label may block image delivery.
zh: 能力声明不限制后端选择；Host标为仅文本可能导致图片无法送达。

en: Image capability unknown; Vision Router tries the adapter and falls through on failure.
zh: 图片能力未知：调用时尝试原生adapter，失败后尝试下一后端。

en: Host text-only strips images before adapter; only verified HTTP Chat Completions can bridge. If supported, enable Image in DSH Settings → Models → Input types. Older Hosts: llm-pi-ai input: [text, image]; llm-deepseek inputModalities: [text, image]. Otherwise skip this backend.
zh: Host 将此模型标为仅文本，adapter 调用前会剥离图片；仅兼容的 HTTP Chat Completions 可桥接。若支持图片，在 DSH「设置 → 模型 → 输入类型」勾选图片；旧 Host 设 llm-pi-ai 的 input: [text, image] 或 llm-deepseek 的 inputModalities: [text, image] 后重载配置，否则跳过此后端。

en: Image capability is checked at call time; failures fall through.
zh: 图片能力待验证；调用失败会尝试下一后端。
没有可选的用户视觉模型

en: DSH reported {count} user models, but none are explicitly marked as accepting images, so Vision Router hid them safely.
zh: 检测到 {count} 个用户模型，但它们都没有被 DSH 明确标记为支持图片，因此已被安全隐藏。

en: image capability could not be verified

zh: 另有 {count} 个模型未显示

en: For a model that truly accepts images, enable Image in DSH Settings → Models → Input types. Older Hosts: set the correct input field in your profile cordis.patch.yml. Extra vision labels cannot change Host pixel delivery.
zh: 若模型确实支持图片，请到 DSH「设置 → 模型 → 输入类型」启用图片并保存；旧 Host 可在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 中声明正确的模型输入类型。仅添加额外视觉模型标记不能改变 Host 图片投递。

en: This saved backend is no longer callable, or is a non-generative/recursive route, so runtime will skip it:
zh: 当前保存的后端已不在可调用模型目录中，或属于非生成式/递归路由，运行时会跳过：

en: These controls are for route overrides, capability labels, and compatibility debugging. Most users can leave them alone.
zh: 这些选项用于路由覆盖、能力标记和兼容调试；一般无需修改。

en: Usually unnecessary. Used only when whole-turn vision routing is enabled and plain text should return to the chat model.
zh: 通常无需设置。仅在开启「整轮交给视觉模型」且需要把纯文字消息切回聊天模型时使用。

en: This setting no longer unlocks the picker or admission: every callable generative model is selectable already. Use it only when you want to explicitly label an undeclared model as visual. This label does not change Host input declarations. Verified HTTP Chat Completions can bridge; other explicit text-only routes fail safely.
zh: 这个设置不再用于“解锁”下拉或允许调用；所有可调用生成式模型本来就能被选择。只有当你希望把某个未声明图片能力的模型明确标记为视觉模型时才需要填写。此标记不会更改 Host 输入声明。仅经验证的 HTTP Chat Completions 渠道可直接桥接；其他纯文本声明会被安全拒绝。

en: Vision Router does not own egress by default: it follows the current DSH/Host network path. The proxy below is only an advanced vision-request override.
zh: 默认不接管网络出口：Vision Router 沿用 DSH/Host 当前网络路径。下方代理只用于需要给视觉请求单独指定出口的高级覆盖。

en: Leave empty to follow the DSH/Host network path. Set only to override vision requests, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:10808 or socks5://127.0.0.1:10808; legacy socks5h:// values are supported. Applies immediately.
zh: 留空即沿用 DSH/Host 网络路径。仅需单独覆盖视觉请求时填写，如 http://127.0.0.1:10808 或 socks5://127.0.0.1:10808；兼容旧配置 socks5h://。修改即时生效。
允许可信 Host 远程修改设置

en: Off by default. Enable only when you trust clients that can reach this DSH instance; trustedHosts is not authentication. Remote clients can change only explicitly allow-listed low-risk preferences; network, credentials, local backends, artifact paths, desktop capture, and host routing remain loopback-only.
zh: 默认关闭。仅在你信任能访问该 DSH 实例的客户端时开启；trustedHosts 不是身份认证。远程端仅能修改明确列入白名单的低风险偏好，网络、凭据、本地后端、产物目录、桌面截图和宿主路由始终只能在本机修改。

en: Vision proxy override hosts (one per line)
zh: 视觉代理覆盖域名（每行一个）

en: Used only when the vision-only proxy override above is set. These hosts use the plugin override; all other requests keep the DSH/Host network path. Empty clears the override.
zh: 仅在上方填写视觉专用代理时生效；这些域名使用插件覆盖，其余请求继续沿用 DSH/Host 网络路径。留空清除覆盖。

en: Save failed: some changes were not written. Unwritten changes were kept; please retry.
zh: 保存失败：部分配置未写入。未写入的修改已保留，请重试。
发现新版本 v{latest}（当前 v{current}）

en: Current v{current} is ahead of registry v{latest}; this may be a source or prerelease build, so no downgrade is suggested.
zh: 当前 v{current} 高于 registry 最新 v{latest}；可能是源码或预发布构建，不会建议降级。

en: The update-check endpoint returned no diagnostic error details
zh: 更新检查接口未返回可诊断的错误详情

en: The update-check endpoint returned an invalid response
zh: 更新检查接口返回了无效响应

en: The current DSH CLI was verified, so Vision Router can update through this same DSH installation. Restart DSH after the update to load the new plugin bundle.
zh: 已安全识别当前 DSH CLI，可直接用这套 DSH 更新插件；完成后需要重启 DSH 才会加载新版本。

en: The current DSH CLI could not be verified safely, so automatic update is disabled. Update through the same DSH/plugin installation path you originally used.
zh: 当前 DSH CLI 无法被安全识别，因此不执行自动更新。请沿用你原来安装 DSH / 插件的方式手动更新。

en: Vision Router will update through the DSH CLI that is currently running. You will need to restart DSH afterward. Continue?
zh: 将通过当前正在运行的 DSH 更新 Vision Router。更新完成后需要重启 DSH。继续吗？

en: The update command completed (target v{latest}). Restart DSH to load the new version.
zh: 更新命令已完成（目标 v{latest}）。请重启 DSH；重启后新版本才会生效。

en: The update command completed (target v{latest}, installed v{installed} verified). Restart DSH to load the new version.
zh: 更新命令已完成（目标 v{latest}，已确认安装 v{installed}）。请重启 DSH；重启后新版本才会生效。

en: The configured registry failed; the check succeeded through the official npm registry.
zh: 当前配置的 registry 不可用，已自动改用 npm 官方源完成检查。

en: npm registry checks failed, so the latest version was resolved from GitHub Releases; installation still requires an accessible npm registry.
zh: npm registry 检查失败，已通过 GitHub Releases 获取最新版本号；安装仍需 npm registry 可访问。

en: The latest version could not be confirmed, so no @latest or plain update command is generated. Open Releases first, confirm the newest version, then replace <version> in the template below.
zh: 无法确认最新版本，因此不会生成 @latest 或普通 update 命令。请先打开 Releases 确认最新版本号，再把下方 <version> 替换为该版本。

en: The command above only uses a confirmed exact version; if no version can be confirmed, the UI shows a <version> template instead. pnpm 11 can silently withhold @latest / plain update for releases younger than 24h (minimumReleaseAge) even while reporting success, so those ambiguous update forms are no longer recommended here.
zh: 上方只会使用已确认的具体版本号；若无法确认版本，则只提供 <version> 模板。pnpm 11 默认会在新版本发布 24 小时内静默拦截 @latest / 普通 update（minimumReleaseAge 策略，但命令仍可能显示成功），所以这里不再推荐这两种模糊更新方式。

en: Send the whole image turn to the vision model
Keep text-only messages on the chat model
zh: 纯文字消息仍使用聊天模型
自动创建「+ 自动识图」模型组

en: Off by default. When enabled, the entire image turn is handled directly by the vision model instead of the current chat model calling vision tools. This preserves legacy behavior and is usually unnecessary; only the vision models configured above participate.
zh: 默认关闭。开启后，发送图片的整轮对话会直接由视觉模型处理，而不是由当前聊天模型调用识图工具。用于兼容旧版行为，一般无需开启；开启后只使用上方识图模型链中的后端。

en: Only applies when whole-turn vision routing is enabled; plain text messages continue to use the chat model.
zh: 仅在「整轮交给视觉模型」开启时生效；纯文字消息继续交给聊天模型处理。

en: Lets the chat model inspect, locate, crop, and compare images as needed. Recommended on.
zh: 允许聊天模型按需查看、定位、裁剪和比较图片。推荐保持开启。

en: Off by default. Each image task first gets one task-independent structured visual baseline with no task goal passed into the pre-scan, then the chat model must make at least one evidence or deepening vision call for the original request (1+x, x>=1). Enabled Ollama / LM Studio backends participate in this same vision chain; there is no separate instant-recognition switch. This improves evidence quality but adds at least one visual call. If OCR is needed, calls without an explicit engine follow the “Default OCR engine” setting; an explicit engine=tesseract/vision always wins for that call. Keep Vision tools enabled.
zh: 默认关闭。开启后，每个图片任务会先做一次不读取具体任务目标的结构化预识别，再由聊天模型根据原问题至少追加一次验证或深挖识图调用（1+x，x≥1）。启用的 Ollama / LM Studio 会和其他视觉后端一样参与这条识图链，不需要另开「即时识图」。准确性更高，但会增加至少一次视觉调用；若后续需要 OCR，未显式指定 engine 时会遵循「OCR 默认引擎」设置；单次显式 engine=tesseract/vision 始终优先。需保持「识图工具」开启。

en: Automatically creates a “+ Auto Vision” version of enabled chat models. Original model groups stay unchanged. Recommended on.
zh: 自动为已启用的聊天模型创建带「+ 自动识图」的版本。原模型不受影响，推荐保持开启。

en: Prevents raw image content from being sent to a text-only model that cannot read it. Recommended on.
zh: 避免把无法读取的原始图片直接发送给纯文字模型。推荐保持开启。

en: Images beyond the pixel budget are resized before the vision call, cutting latency and cost; on by default.
zh: 超过像素预算的图片先缩放再送视觉模型，降低延迟与成本；默认开启。

en: Caches vision answers (keyed by image content + question); on by default.
zh: 缓存识图答案（按图片内容 + 问题）；默认开启。

en: When enabled, only visual backends on loopback addresses may run. Cloud/DSH providers and the OVH free fallback are blocked at runtime, so Vision Router does not send image bytes or crops to cloud vision services. Derived result text—descriptions, OCR, and coordinates—is still passed to the current chat model; if that model is remote, image semantics may still leave this machine. For a strict end-to-end local workflow, select a local chat model too.
zh: 开启后仅允许回环地址上的本地视觉后端；云端/DSH Provider 与 OVH 免费兜底会被运行时硬阻止，因此 Vision Router 不会把图片和裁剪发送到云端视觉服务。视觉后端返回的描述、OCR、坐标等识图结果文本仍会交给当前聊天模型；若聊天模型在云端，图片语义仍可能离开本机。严格纯本地还需同时选择本地聊天模型。

en: If your selected vision models fail, automatically try the built-in OVH free models. No signup or API key required.
zh: 当你选择的识图模型都不可用时，自动尝试内置 OVH 免费模型。免注册、免 API Key。

en: Off by default. When enabled, cloud backends try the built-in OVH free models first (no signup, no API key), and your paid endpoints only act as a fallback after every free model fails, keeping cloud vision at zero cost. Local backends are unaffected and stay first. When off, the existing order is preserved (paid first, free appended last).
zh: 默认关闭。开启后，云端后端先尝试内置 OVH 免费模型（免注册、免 API Key），你配置的付费端点仅在免费模型全部失败后作为兜底，尽量把云端识别成本降到零。本地后端不受影响，仍在最前。关闭时保持既有顺序（付费在前、免费补全在后）。

en: Lets the model capture the desktop on demand for image understanding. Off by default; vision_screenshot is exposed only when enabled. On macOS, saving the enabled setting immediately triggers a screen-recording permission check; if permission was already granted, macOS will not prompt again.
zh: 允许模型按需截取桌面屏幕用于识图。默认关闭；开启后才提供 vision_screenshot 工具。macOS 在保存开启时会立即触发一次屏幕录制授权检查；如果已经授权，系统不会重复弹窗。

en: Retained only for persisted-setting compatibility. On every DSH Host supported by DVR 2.3, the official provider stays Host-owned: Vision Router uses the “+ Auto Vision” wrapper and never takes over or reconstructs deepseek-official, nor asks you to disable llm-deepseek. Custom routes like opencode are auto-wrapped by default; use the manual wrapper section below only when you want to restrict their scope.
zh: 仅保留旧配置字段兼容。DVR 2.3 支持的 DSH 中官方 provider 始终归 Host 所有，Vision Router 只使用「+ 自动识图」包装，不再接管或重建 deepseek-official，也不要求你禁用 llm-deepseek。opencode 等自定义路由默认自动包装，只有要限制范围时才用下方手动包装。

en: The official DeepSeek provider is disabled or unavailable, but this DSH Host owns that provider route. Vision Router will not recreate it. Re-enable llm-deepseek, then use the “+ Auto Vision” wrapper / Vision control for image tasks.
zh: 检测到官方 DeepSeek provider 被禁用或不可用，但当前 DSH 已由 Host 负责该路由。Vision Router 不会自行重建它。请重新启用 llm-deepseek，再通过「+ 自动识图」包装 /「👁 识图」处理图片任务。
单次识图请求超时（毫秒）
识图任务最长时间（毫秒）

en: Default policy when vision_ocr does not explicitly choose an engine. Auto tries local Tesseract first and falls back to the vision model; Tesseract uses local OCR only; Vision skips Tesseract. An explicit engine=tesseract/vision on a tool call always wins.
zh: 决定 vision_ocr 未显式指定 engine 时的默认策略。自动：先本地 Tesseract，失败/空结果再用视觉模型；Tesseract：只用本地 OCR；视觉模型：直接跳过 Tesseract。单次工具调用显式 engine=tesseract/vision 始终优先。

en: Usually nothing to set here. Vision uses built-in guidance per image type by default; you can write a custom guidance line for a specific type (e.g. document, UI, person) so the vision model looks the way you want. Example: pick "document（文档）" and enter "Focus on contract clauses and signatures."
zh: 一般不需要设置。识图时默认按图片类型自动使用内置引导；你可以为某个图片类型（如文档、界面、人物）写一句自己的引导语，让视觉模型按你的要求细看。例如选「document（文档）」，填「重点关注合同条款与签名」。
输入自定义引导语（留空 = 使用内置）

en: Vision depth chooses the inspection strategy, not a call-count limit: Quick stays overall-first, Standard verifies evidence as needed, and Thorough proactively inspects details and cross-checks important claims. To cap calls, enable “Limit deep-dive calls” below.
zh: 看图深度只决定识图策略，不限制调用次数：快速优先整体判断，标准按问题需要查证，细致会主动做更多局部检查与交叉验证。如需限制调用次数，请启用下方「限制深挖次数」。

en: Off by default, so visual evidence calls are unlimited. Enable this to cap successful deep-evidence calls for the turn. The bootstrap pre-scan does not count, and failed or empty-evidence calls do not consume the cap.
zh: 默认关闭，不限制视觉证据调用次数。启用后可设置本轮最多允许多少次成功的深挖证据调用；bootstrap 预识别不计入，失败或空证据调用不占次数。
请输入 1–100 之间的整数。
单个视觉请求超时；默认 120000。

en: One vision task (all providers, fallbacks and retries) shares this wall-clock budget; default 120000. Auth failures and rate limits trip their backend immediately.
zh: 一次识图任务（含全部 provider、回退与重试）共享的总时限；默认 120000。认证失败/限流会立即熔断对应后端。

en: Total budget for one OCR task: tesseract gets at most 12s, the vision fallback only the remainder; default 30000.
zh: 一次 OCR 任务的总时限；本地 tesseract 最多用 12 秒，视觉模型回退只用剩余部分；默认 30000。

en: About 8MP = 8000000; larger images are resized before the vision call.
zh: 约 8MP = 8000000；超过的图先缩放再送视觉模型。

en: Vision answer cache lifetime; 0 = forever; default 3600.
zh: 视觉答案缓存有效期；0 = 永久；默认 3600。
缓存 LRU 容量；默认 200。

en: The auto-vision entry route shown in the model picker.
zh: 模型选择器里显示的「自动识图」入口路由名。

en: The fallback chain mount route (vision tools call real providers directly, not through it).
zh: 视觉链的挂载路由名（识图工具经由真实 provider 直接调用，不经过它）。
手动限定自动识图范围（可选）

en: Usually leave this alone. Use it only after disabling automatic creation, or when only selected models should appear in a “+ Auto Vision” group: one `provider` wraps all models, while `provider/model1,model2` limits the set. Applies immediately; no restart.
zh: 通常不用配置。只有关闭自动创建，或只想让某些模型出现在「+ 自动识图」组时才使用：每行 `provider` 包装全部模型，或 `provider/model1,model2` 只包装指定模型。改动即时生效，无需重启。

en: Usually no configuration is needed: enabled models from Settings → Models are discovered and wrapped automatically. Add rows here only to restrict one provider’s auto-vision scope, or after turning off automatic creation above. Empty model = every model on that route. The original model group always remains untouched. Applies immediately; no restart.
zh: 通常无需配置：默认会自动发现并包装「设置 → 模型」里已启用的模型。只有想限制某个 provider 的自动识图范围，或关闭上方自动创建后手动指定时才在这里添加；模型留空 = 该路由全部模型。原模型组始终保留不变。改动即时生效，无需重启。
全部模型（不选 = 包装全部）

en: One vision model per line, tried from top to bottom. Leave empty to rely on the built-in free fallback.
zh: 每行一个识图模型，从上到下依次尝试；留空则只使用内置免费兜底。

en: View the plugin market version and settings.
zh: 查看插件市场版本与设置。

en: Updating downloads the new version; it takes effect after a restart.
zh: 更新会下载新版本，重启后生效。

en: This copy was installed by the desktop app; update it from there.
zh: 这份市场由桌面端安装，新版本请在桌面端更新。

en: Downloaded. Restart DeepSeek Harness for it to take effect — the page will already show the new version.
zh: 已下载完成。重启 DeepSeek Harness 后新版本才会生效——页面会先显示新版本号。

en: Shows the market below Plugins in the sidebar.
zh: 在侧栏「插件」下方显示市场。

en: This host has no market page in Settings, so this row is the only way in and stays on.
zh: 这个宿主没有市场设置页，这一行是唯一的入口，不能关闭。

en: Where the market appears. Keep at least one entry.
zh: 控制市场在界面中的入口。至少保留一个。

en: Shows the market section in Settings.
zh: 在设置中显示插件市场分区。

en: Shows the market tab beside Installed on the Plugins page.
zh: 在插件页「已安装」旁显示插件市场页签。

en: Keep at least one entry; this is the only one left.
zh: 至少保留一个入口；这是当前唯一可用的入口。

en: On dsh 0.2.1 and newer, add https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json under Plugins → Discover → Index sources — the official Discover tab and the plugin_market agent tool then search the same catalog.
zh: dsh 0.2.1 起，官方的「插件 → 发现 → 索引源」可以添加 https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json —— 官方发现页和 plugin_market 智能体工具会搜索同一份目录。

en: Want a quicker open? Show it in the sidebar.
zh: 想更快打开？可在侧栏显示。

en: Downloads directly from npm and GitHub.
zh: 从 npm 和 GitHub 官方源下载。

en: Faster in mainland China. Changes the download route, not the source.
zh: 中国大陆访问更快。仅改变下载线路，插件来源不变。

en: Selected from a network check. Change it anytime.
zh: 已根据网络状况自动选择，可随时切换。

en: Chooses a working route automatically and switches only after a failure.
zh: 自动选择可用线路，失败时才切换。

en: Tries your custom route first, then falls back to GitHub directly.
zh: 优先使用自定义线路，失败后仍会尝试直连。

en: Managed by DSHM_GITHUB_PROXY and cannot be changed here.
zh: 由环境变量 DSHM_GITHUB_PROXY 管理，界面中不可修改。

en: Reaches every process the market runs — installs, builds, git — not just the compiler. One KEY=value per line, e.g. CC=/usr/bin/gcc-11. PATH and CI are managed by the market. Saving an empty list restores the original config.
zh: 作用于市场启动的每个进程（安装、编译、git 等），不只是编译器。每行一个 KEY=value，例如 CC=/usr/bin/gcc-11；PATH 和 CI 由市场管理。留空保存即恢复原有配置。

en: Early access to unverified versions. Affects the plugin market only.
zh: 提前获取待验证版本，可能不稳定。仅影响插件市场自身。

en: Unverified builds from a development branch. Not recommended for general use.
zh: 开发分支构建，未经验证，不建议普通用户使用。

en: This version is lower than the one installed.
zh: 该版本低于当前已安装版本。

en: Uninstall the market from this profile. Your other plugins are untouched.
zh: 从这个 profile 卸载市场。已装的其它插件不受影响。

en: This page was not opened on the machine running DSH, so the market cannot remove itself from here. Remove it there: Settings → Plugins on the desktop app, or the command line elsewhere.
zh: 这个页面不是从本机打开的，市场没法从这里卸载自己。请到运行 DSH 的那台机器上移除：桌面端用「设置 → 插件」，其它环境用命令行。

en: Uninstall the plugin market? Reinstalling it requires the command line.
zh: 确定要卸载插件市场吗？卸载后需使用命令行重新安装。

en: Also clear the market's own data
zh: 同时清除市场自己的数据

en: Will delete: the market's disable list and custom groups, plus the disable entries it wrote into your config file — plugins it switched off will run again. No passwords or tokens are involved; the market never stores those on disk.
zh: 将删除：市场的停用清单与自定义分组，以及它写进配置文件的停用记录——被停用的插件将恢复运行。不涉及密码或密钥，市场从不把它们存在磁盘上。

en: Keeps the market's data. Note: plugins the market switched off stay off, and once it is removed there is no UI left to switch them back on.
zh: 保留市场数据。注意：被市场停用的插件会保持停用，且移除后将没有界面可将其重新启用。

en: Restart DeepSeek Harness to finish cleaning up.
zh: 重启 DeepSeek Harness 后完全清理。

en: Plugin market version — include it when reporting an issue
zh: 插件市场版本 — 反馈问题时请附上

en: Discover community plugins for DeepSeek Harness
zh: 发现社区为 DeepSeek Harness 开发的插件
搜索插件，例如：通知、终端、记忆…

en: {0} found, {1} less common among scanned plugins
zh: {0} 项，{1} 项在已扫描插件里较少出现

en: Filled items are less common among scanned plugins
zh: 实心的项在已扫描的插件里较少出现

en: runs code it assembles at runtime
zh: 会在运行时执行拼出来的代码
用到 DSH 宿主内部的包

en: Nothing found — which is not the same as safe.
zh: 没有扫描到。这不等于安全。

en: A static scan only shows what it found. “Nothing found” is not “safe”.
zh: 静态扫描只能证明「有」，不能证明「没有」。这不代表它安全。

en: connects to servers and uses your API keys
zh: 会联网，并用到你的密钥

en: connects to the fixed IP address {0}
zh: 会直接连接固定 IP 地址（{0}）

en: runs its own script the moment you install — you do not have to open the plugin
zh: 安装时会立刻运行它自带的脚本，不需要你打开插件

en: runs {0} the moment you install — you do not have to open the plugin
zh: 安装时会立刻运行 {0}，不需要你打开插件
会改动 DSH 自带的组件
会改动 DSH 自带的组件（{0}）

en: overrides a part of DSH itself ({0})
zh: 会覆盖 DSH 自带的组件（{0}）

en: disables a part of DSH itself ({0})
zh: 会禁用 DSH 自带的组件（{0}）

en: No favorites yet. Use the bookmark icon in Discover or Themes, or “Add to favorites” in an installed row’s “···” menu.
zh: 还没有收藏。在「发现」或「主题」里点书签图标，或在「已安装」的「···」里加入收藏。

en: Bookmarked entries are no longer in the catalog.
zh: 收藏的条目已不在目录中。

en: {0} favorites are no longer in the catalog
Removed from Discover. Undo it in Hidden, the tab after Installed.
zh: 已从发现页移出。在「已安装」后面的「已屏蔽」里可以取消。

en: These stay off Discover, and Update all skips them.
zh: 这些插件不在发现页显示，全部更新也会跳过。

en: Matching plugins are on the Hidden tab.
zh: 匹配的插件在「已屏蔽」标签里。

en: Could not update the hidden list. Try again.
zh: 无法更新屏蔽列表，请重试。

en: change(s) pending restart — restart DeepSeek Harness to apply
zh: 项变更需重启 DeepSeek Harness 后生效

en: This removes the plugin from the current profile.
zh: 将从当前 profile 中移除该插件。

en: Removing this library may stop plugins that use it from starting.
zh: 删除这个依赖库后，使用它的插件可能无法启动。

en: To restart: stop the current dsh process and run it again (e.g. dsh web)
zh: 重启方式：关闭当前 dsh 进程后重新运行（例如 dsh web）

en: This process is {0}'s own service process, so restarts belong to it — restarting from here would kill the takeover process along with the cgroup and the service would not come back. Use systemctl restart <your unit>. If your unit can survive a self-restart (KillMode=process), turn Allow restart on in this plugin's configuration.
zh: 本进程是 {0} 服务的主进程，重启交给它负责——市场自己重启会连带杀掉 cgroup 里的接管进程，服务将起不来。请执行 systemctl restart <你的 unit>。确认你的配置能承受市场自行重启（如 KillMode=process），可在本插件配置里手动打开「允许重启」。

en: This dsh process is under a debugger. Stop it from your IDE or terminal and start it again — the market cannot stop the debugged process from the UI.
zh: 当前 dsh 进程正被调试器连接。请从 IDE 或终端停止该进程后重新启动，市场不能从界面里结束正在调试的 dsh。

en: You are reaching dsh through a proxy or gateway, and for safety restart only accepts a direct local connection. Restart it on the machine running dsh, for example with docker restart or kubectl rollout restart.
zh: 你是通过代理或网关访问的，出于安全，重启只接受本机直连。请在运行 dsh 的机器上重启它，例如 docker restart 或 kubectl rollout restart。

en: Community third-party plugin. Build scripts do not run by default.
zh: 社区第三方插件，构建脚本默认不运行。

en: May not work in the web app
This is a terminal plugin. It may not work in the web version.
zh: 这是终端插件，网页版里可能用不了。

en: It can stop DeepSeek Harness from starting.
zh: 也可能让 DeepSeek Harness 起不来。

en: No community plugins yet — browse the Discover tab
zh: 尚未安装社区插件，可前往「发现」页浏览

en: DSH unloaded the market while reloading plugins. Restart DSH to bring it back. The last operation may already have finished.
zh: DSH 重新加载插件时把市场一起卸载了。重启 DSH 即可恢复；刚才的操作可能已经完成。

en: DSH unloaded the market, so this operation got no result. Once the market is back, check Installed.
zh: 市场被 DSH 卸载了，这次操作没有等到结果。市场恢复后，到「已安装」里确认。

en: The plugin catalog failed to load. Try again later.
zh: 插件目录加载失败，请稍后重试

en: change(s) applied — refresh the page to see them
Another install, update or uninstall is still running — wait for it to finish, then try again.
zh: 另一个安装、更新或卸载还在进行，请等它完成后再试

en: An agent is currently working — wait for it to finish (or cancel it) before updating. Updates replace plugin files in place, so a working agent can fail or mix versions mid-turn.
zh: 有 Agent 正在运行，请等它完成或先取消，再更新——更新会直接替换插件文件，运行中的 Agent 可能中途报错或新旧版本混用。

en: An agent is currently working — wait for it to finish (or cancel it) before installing. Installing changes plugin files, so a working agent can fail mid-turn.
zh: 有 Agent 正在运行，请等它完成或先取消，再安装——安装会改动插件文件，运行中的 Agent 可能中途报错。

en: Agent is busy — queued and will install automatically when idle (cancel it in Tasks, top right).
zh: Agent 正忙，已排队，空闲后自动安装（可在右上角「任务」里取消）。

en: Agent is busy — queued and will update automatically when idle (cancel it in Tasks, top right).
zh: Agent 正忙，已排队，空闲后自动更新（可在右上角「任务」里取消）。

en: Agent is busy — queued and will uninstall automatically when idle (cancel it in Tasks, top right).
zh: Agent 正忙，已排队，空闲后自动卸载（可在右上角「任务」里取消）。

en: {0} session(s) are running, so this cannot start yet: these operations replace plugin files in place, and a working agent can fail mid-turn. It will begin on its own once they go idle (or cancel this entry in Tasks).
zh: 有 {0} 个会话正在运行，现在还不能执行：这类操作会直接替换插件文件，运行中的 Agent 可能中途报错。它们空闲后会自动开始（也可以先在「任务」里取消这一条）。

en: Another install, update or uninstall is still running, so this cannot start yet: it stays queued and begins on its own when that one finishes — no need to press again.
zh: 另一个安装、更新或卸载还在进行，现在还不能开始：这一条留在队列里，等它完成后会自动开始，不需要再点一次。

en: The plugin this entry was going to install is no longer in the catalog (it was refreshed or you changed pages), so the entry was removed. Find it in the catalog and install it again.
zh: 这一条要装的插件在当前目录里找不到了（目录刷新过或换了页），已从队列移除。请在目录里重新找到它再装一次。

en: It was installed when you queued this, and is not now — skipped, nothing was uninstalled.
zh: 排队时它还在已安装列表里，现在已不在，因此跳过（没有卸载）。

en: It had an update available when you queued this, and does not now — skipped.
zh: 排队时它有可用更新，现在没有了，已跳过。

en: Waiting for {0} Agent(s) to reach a safe point…
zh: 等待 {0} 个 Agent 到达安全点…

en: The host restarted before this finished, so the task was cancelled. Start it again if you still need it.
zh: 宿主在这次操作完成前重启了，它已取消。需要的话请重新发起。
上次排队的操作已完成。

en: The last deferred operation failed ({0}). Check Installed or the exported log.
zh: 上次排队的操作失败了（{0}）。请检查「已安装」或导出的日志。

en: The last deferred operation failed. Check Installed or the exported log.
zh: 上次排队的操作失败了。请检查「已安装」或导出的日志。

en: The last deferred operation was cancelled.
zh: 上次排队的操作已取消。

en: Could not update favorites. Try again.
Favorites are unavailable. Refresh the page or restart dsh web.
zh: 收藏功能暂不可用。请刷新页面或重启 dsh web。

en: A plugin operation is still running. Favorites were not saved — try again shortly.
zh: 插件操作未结束，收藏未保存，请稍后重试

en: Compatibility risk detected — open Diagnostics before restarting, or roll this operation back.
zh: 检测到兼容性风险，建议重启前到诊断页处理，或回滚本次操作。

en: Compatibility risk detected — open Diagnostics before restarting.
zh: 检测到兼容性风险，建议重启前到诊断页处理。

en: One plugin name is now defined in two places (informational only, not a conflict):
zh: 此操作后，同一个插件名出现在两处（仅供参考，不算冲突）：

en: These plugins have damaged UI files. The page may be blank after a refresh; rolling back is recommended:
zh: 下列插件的界面文件已损坏，刷新后页面可能空白，建议回滚：

en: Automatic rollback is unavailable because the previous exact source could not be verified.
zh: 无法确认更新前的准确来源，自动回滚不可用。

en: This plugin needs its build scripts to run; they are blocked by default for safety. If you trust the source, allow them and reinstall:
zh: 该插件需要运行构建脚本才能工作，出于安全考虑已默认阻止。确认来源可信后，可放行并重新安装：

en: Timed out waiting for DeepSeek Harness to start
zh: 等待 DeepSeek Harness 启动超时

en: Latest {0} was just released; about {1} hours to wait. Update to {2} for now.
zh: 最新版 {0} 刚发布，还要约 {1} 小时。先更新到 {2}。

en: The release time of latest {0} is unknown, so it still needs to wait. Update to {2} for now.
zh: 最新版 {0} 的发布时间暂不确定，还需等待。先更新到 {2}。

en: This profile waits a while before it installs a fresh release; about {1} hour(s) left.
zh: 这个 profile 要求新版本发布满一段时间才允许安装，大约还要 {1} 小时。

en: The new version is listed, but the registry mirror has not caught up with its metadata, so the update is held; the market checks again in about {1} minute(s).
zh: 新版本已经出现在 /latest，但镜像的完整信息还没同步，所以先不提供更新；大约 {1} 分钟后会重新检查。

en: The package's latest tag has no update; the prerelease line you are on published a newer build.
zh: npm 上的 latest 没有更新；你在跟的这条预发布线发布了更新的版本。

en: The selected branch has commits newer than your install, but no new version was published; the market installs releases only and will not apply them automatically.
zh: 所选分支上有比你已装版本更新的提交，但没有发布新版本号；市场只安装正式版本，不会自动装这些提交。

en: Installed and updated by the desktop app; update it there.
zh: 本市场由桌面端安装和更新，新版本请在桌面端更新

en: Recent commits (do not match your installed version — for reference only)
zh: 最近提交（无法对应你当前安装的版本，仅供参考）

en: This plugin does not publish update notes.
zh: 该插件未提供更新说明。

en: The market doesn't have update notes for this plugin yet.
zh: 市场还没收录这个插件的更新说明。

en: This plugin was not installed from GitHub, so the market cannot read its change history.
zh: 这个插件不是从 GitHub 装的，市场读不到它的改动记录。

en: See what changed in the repository
You can ask the plugin author what changed.
zh: 可以问问插件作者改了什么。

en: Update notes are unavailable right now — try again later.
zh: 暂时读不到更新说明，稍后再试。

en: This changes the plugin's install source rather than its version.
zh: 这会更改插件的安装来源，而不是普通版本更新。

en: The npm package may be published by someone else and not be the same plugin. Continue only if you trust it.
zh: 该 npm 包可能由其他人发布，并非同一插件；确认可信后再继续。

en: Migrate to the new name and update?
This plugin has a new npm package name, and the old one no longer gets new versions. Migrating moves the install to the new name; switches, groups and notes stay.
zh: 这个插件换了 npm 包名，旧名字不再发新版本。迁移会把安装换成新名字，开关、分组和备注都保留。

en: Data the plugin saved itself (personas, habits, bindings) is not part of the market; migrating leaves it alone.
zh: 插件自己保存的数据（人格、习惯、绑定）不归市场管，迁移不会动它们。

en: This uninstalls the local version and installs the online version. Update checks continue as usual. This cannot be undone.
zh: 将卸载本地版本并安装线上版本，之后照常检查更新。此操作无法撤销。

en: This release needs a newer DSH
zh: 这个新版本要求更新的 DSH

en:
{plugin} declares that it needs DSH {requirement}, and you are running {host}. Installing it would most likely break the plugin, leaving a manual downgrade as the only way back.
Nothing was changed — the plugin is still on its current version.
If you know the version number is wrong (a bundled DSH that does not report one, for example), you can update anyway.
zh:
{plugin} 声明需要 DSH {requirement}，而你现在运行的是 {host}。装上去很可能用不了，只能手动装回旧版。
已停止，插件仍是原来的版本。
如果你确定这个版本号不准（例如桌面端自带的 DSH 不报告版本），仍可继续更新。

en: Looking for a version that still supports this DSH…
zh: 正在查找还兼容当前 DSH 的版本…

en: You can install {version} — it declares support for this DSH.
zh: 可以装 {version}：它声明兼容当前 DSH。

en: You can update to {version} — it declares support for this DSH.
zh: 可以更新到 {version}：它声明兼容当前 DSH。

en: {version} does declare support for this DSH, but it is still inside the release-age wait — a new release has to settle for {window} hours, so about {hours} more to go.
zh: 可以选 {version}：它声明兼容当前 DSH，但还在发布等待期——新版本发布后要等 {window} 小时才算稳定，还差约 {hours} 小时。

en: {version} does declare support for this DSH, but it is still inside the release-age wait, and this host cannot work out how long is left.
zh: 可以选 {version}：它声明兼容当前 DSH，但还在发布等待期，暂时算不出还要等多久。
还在等待期（约 {hours} 小时）

en: No version declares support for this DSH.
zh: 没有找到声明兼容当前 DSH 的版本。

en: Could not look up compatible versions.

zh: 符合宿主要求（依据声明）
确证与当前 DSH 不兼容

en:
{plugin} declares that it needs DSH {requirement}, and you are running {host}. Installing it would most likely break the plugin.
Nothing was installed.
If you know the version number is wrong (a bundled DSH that does not report one, for example), you can install anyway.
zh:
{plugin} 声明需要 DSH {requirement}，而你现在运行的是 {host}。装上去很可能用不了。
已停止，没有安装任何东西。
如果你确定这个版本号不准（例如桌面端自带的 DSH 不报告版本），仍可继续安装。

en: Your local copy does not name its source repository, so the market could only match it by package name. The plugin below may be another author's plugin with the same name, not the source of your copy. Check the owner and repository before confirming. This uninstalls the local version, installs that plugin, and cannot be undone.
zh: 本地副本未注明来源仓库，市场只能按包名在精选目录中匹配。下方插件可能是其他作者的同名插件，并非你本地副本的来源。确认前请核对作者和仓库地址。此操作会卸载本地版本并安装该插件，无法撤销。

en: This plugin is not in the curated catalog, so it cannot be restored. Uninstall the local copy, or keep developing it locally.
zh: 精选目录里没有这个插件，无法恢复到线上版本。可以卸载本地版，或继续用本地开发。

en: A same-named plugin exists in the catalog, but it does not match your local repository, so restore is not safe. Uninstall the local copy, or keep developing it locally.
zh: 精选目录里有同名插件，但与你本地仓库不一致，无法安全恢复。可以卸载本地版，或继续用本地开发。

en: The plugin market could not be displayed

'The market could not be displayed. Your plugins are unaffected and nothing was changed.
Reload usually fixes this. If it keeps happening, export the log and attach it to an issue — the log records where the error occurred.
If your browser is translating this page, turn translation off and reload. This is a known cause.'
zh:
市场界面未能正常显示，你的插件不受影响，也没有任何改动。
点击「重新加载」通常即可恢复。如反复出现，请导出日志并提交 issue，日志会记录出错位置。
如果开启了浏览器网页翻译，请关闭后重试，这是已知原因之一。

en: Log exported: dsh-market-log.txt — please attach it to your issue
zh: 日志已导出：dsh-market-log.txt，请将其附在 issue 中

en: Comments come from GitHub Discussions. Opening this connects to giscus.app and GitHub; posting needs a GitHub account.
zh: 评论来自 GitHub Discussions。打开后会连接 giscus.app 与 GitHub；发表评论需要 GitHub 账号。

en: Signing in here leaves this page; you will need to reopen dsh web — nothing is broken. Post on GitHub; this page is for reading only.
zh: 在这里登录会离开本页，返回时需重新打开 dsh web——这不是故障。发表评论请到 GitHub，本页只用于阅读。

en: Comments could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
zh: 评论加载失败。请检查网络连接后重试。

en: Sign in and join on GitHub
zh: 在 GitHub 登录并参与讨论

en: Cannot install: conflicts with an installed plugin
zh: 无法安装：与已安装的插件冲突

en: It conflicts with an installed plugin — only one can stay:
zh: 和已安装的插件冲突，只能留一个：
已自动撤销，未改动任何插件

en: Settings of the uninstalled plugins are kept, so you can reinstall later
zh: 被卸载的插件配置会保留，可以再装回来

en: cordis rejects duplicate entry ids; keeping this plugin would stop DeepSeek Harness from starting.
zh: cordis 不接受重复的条目 id，保留它会让 DeepSeek Harness 下次启动失败。

en: {0} task(s) waiting for agents to go idle
zh: {0} 个任务等待 agent 空闲

en: Cannot install · reverted automatically, nothing changed
zh: 无法安装 · 已自动撤销，未改动任何插件

en: Installed · refresh the page to apply
zh: 已安装 · 刷新页面后生效

en: You can leave this page; you will be notified when it finishes
zh: 可离开本页面，完成后将通知你

en: Starts on its own once the agents go idle
Install, update and uninstall progress appears here
zh: 安装、更新与卸载的进度将显示在这里

en: Sessions are running. This operation replaces or removes plugin files, so running sessions may fail mid-turn. Cancel and wait for them to finish if you do not want to take this risk.
zh: 有会话正在运行。此操作会替换或删除插件文件。运行中的会话可能中途报错。不想冒险可取消，等会话结束再试。
无法安装 · 查看详情

en: You kept the installed plugins; this one was not installed
zh: 已选择保留现有插件，未安装

en: Replace did not finish. These plugins were uninstalled and not restored — reinstall them:
zh: 替换未完成。下列插件已卸载且未恢复，请重新安装：

en: pnpm needs to be set up before installing plugins
zh: 安装插件前需要先配置 pnpm 环境

en: Automatic setup failed. Export the log and attach it to your issue.
zh: 自动配置失败。请导出日志并附在 issue 中。

en: The desktop app installs plugins itself — use the Install button above; `dsh plugin` refuses this profile.
zh: 桌面端的插件由应用自己安装（用上面的「安装」按钮）；`dsh plugin` 不接受桌面端这个 profile。

en: Checking host requirements {0}/{1}; undeclared or unavailable plugins remain visible
zh: 正在检查宿主要求 {0}/{1}；未声明或无法确认的插件仍会显示

en: Hid {1} plugins incompatible with DSH {0}; those declaring no version stay listed
zh: 已隐藏 {1} 个与 DSH {0} 不兼容的插件；未声明版本的仍在列表里
近 30 天 npm 下载：{0}

en: GitHub Release asset downloads, all time: {0} (packages, checksums and companion files)
zh: GitHub 发行附件累计下载：{0}（包括安装包、校验和配套文件）

en: the installable version as of the catalog's last refresh ({0}); a release published since then appears after the next refresh
zh: 目录（{0} 更新）记录的安装版本；新发行需等待目录更新

en: the installable version as of the catalog's last refresh — the catalog updates daily, so newer project releases may not appear yet
zh: 目录记录的安装版本；可能滞后于项目的新发行

en: Installed, but not the newest: this profile's minimumReleaseAge held {0} back, so {1} was installed.
zh: 已安装，但不是最新版：这个 profile 的 minimumReleaseAge 挡住了 {0}，安装的是 {1}。

en: Installed, but the version could not be confirmed: both registry lookups failed, so {0} is what pnpm chose. The plugin page shows the version actually on disk.
zh: 已安装，但版本没能确认：registry 两次都查不到，这次装的是 {0}。插件页会显示实际版本，可以在那里核对。

en: Installed, but the version could not be confirmed: both registry lookups failed. The plugin page shows the version actually on disk.
zh: 已安装，但版本没能确认：registry 两次都查不到。插件页会显示实际版本，可以在那里核对。

en: {0} more packages came in as dependencies of plugins — they are not plugins, so they are not listed above.
zh: 另有 {0} 个包是插件带进来的依赖，不是插件，未列在上方。

en: New versions stay listed. Only the reminder stops.
zh: 新版本仍会列出，只是不再提醒。

en: Update reminders are off. New versions stay listed.
zh: 更新提醒已关闭。新版本仍会列出。

en: Includes the plugin list and profile configuration, not the plugin files. Restore reinstalls them from the list.
zh: 仅包含插件清单和 profile 配置，不含插件文件；恢复时按清单重新安装。

en: Back up daily (when the market opens)
zh: 每天自动备份（打开市场时）

en: The WebDAV URL and username stay in this browser only; the password lives in this page and has to be re-entered after a reload.
zh: WebDAV 地址与用户名仅保存在当前浏览器；密码只留在当前页面，刷新或重启后需要重新输入。

en: Daily backup could not run: this server needs a password, and the password is never stored, so it has to be entered again after a reload. Enter it and press Upload backup.
zh: 每天自动备份没能完成：这个服务需要密码认证，而密码不会保存到磁盘，刷新或重启后要重新输入。填好后点「上传备份」即可。

en: Give the whole file path, name included: the backup writes that file and restore reads it back. With automatic backup on it uploads at most once a day.
zh: 填完整的文件地址（含文件名）：备份写进这个文件，恢复也从它读。开启自动备份后每天最多上传一次。

en: The WebDAV URL and username stay in this browser only.
zh: WebDAV 地址和用户名只保存在此浏览器。

en: Note: backups include profile configuration and files that may hold secrets (config.toml, .env, …). Local exports are unmodified, so upload only to a WebDAV target you trust.
zh: 请注意：备份包含 profile 配置，以及可能含密钥的文件（config.toml、.env 等）。本地导出的文件会原样包含这些内容，上传 WebDAV 前请确认目标可信。

en: GitHub token (session memory only — re-enter after refresh; leave empty to use server-side DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN or a logged-in gh CLI)
zh: GitHub token（仅本次会话内存，刷新后需重新输入；留空则使用服务端 DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN 或已登录的 gh CLI）

en: Gist ID or URL (leave empty on export to create a new private Gist)
zh: Gist ID 或链接（导出留空则新建私有 Gist）

en: All checked = full backup (config included); otherwise only the checked plugins are exported, plus “include config” if ticked.
zh: 全选 = 完整备份（含配置文件）；否则只导出勾选的插件，可另勾「包含配置文件」。
包含配置文件（可能含密钥）

en: This profile has no plugins to export
zh: 当前 profile 没有可导出的插件

en: GitHub request timed out — check your network and retry
zh: GitHub 请求超时，请检查网络后重试

en: Cannot reach GitHub — check your network or proxy
zh: 无法连接 GitHub，请检查网络或代理设置

en: GitHub authentication failed: invalid/expired token, or gh CLI not logged in
zh: GitHub 认证失败：Token 无效、已过期，或 gh CLI 未登录

en: Gist not found — check the ID or URL
zh: 未找到该 Gist，请检查 ID 或链接

en: GitHub rate limit hit, or the token lacks the gist scope
zh: GitHub 限流或 Token 权限不足

en: Gist content is invalid or uses an unsupported backup format
zh: Gist 内容无效或备份格式不受支持

en: Update the Gist in the field
zh: 更新到输入框中的 Gist

en: Update mode needs a Gist ID — fill it in, or switch to “Create”
zh: 更新模式需要 Gist ID：请填写，或切换为「新建」

en: Unlike local export (this-machine archive), Gist is for cross-machine sync: export to a private Gist, then import it on another computer with the same account to reuse your plugins. The token lives in this session's memory only and is never written to browser storage; a logged-in gh CLI or DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN skips entering it. Gists are private, 1 MB per file.
zh: 与本地导出（本机存档）不同，Gist 用于跨机器同步：导出到私有 Gist 后，可在其他电脑用同一账号导入复用。Token 仅保存在本次会话内存中，绝不写入浏览器存储；已登录 gh CLI 或设置 DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN 则无需输入。Gist 为私有，单文件上限 1 MB。
恢复完成，请重启 DeepSeek Harness

en: Restore completed, but these plugins failed to install:
zh: 恢复已完成，但下列插件安装失败：

en: installs from a path on another computer that does not exist here — reinstall or point it to a local path
zh: 安装来源是另一台电脑上的本地路径，本机找不到。请重新安装该插件，或改为本机路径

en: the market keeps its own version during a restore — swapping it mid-restore would replace the running market. Update it separately when you want the newer one
zh: 市场自身的版本不会随恢复改变（否则会在恢复途中替换掉正在运行的自己）。需要时请用「更新」单独升级

en: Still cannot boot after the restore:
⚠️ The next start will fail: the profile declares these plugins but they are not installed. Reinstall them, or remove them from dsh.profile.bundles in the profile package.json:
zh: ⚠️ 下次启动会失败：profile 声明了这些插件，但它们没有安装。请重新安装，或从 profile 的 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 中删除：

en: Restore will overwrite this profile configuration and reinstall plugins. Continue?
zh: 恢复将覆盖当前 profile 配置并重新安装插件，确定继续吗？

en: Backup imported. Review Installed, then start restore.
zh: 备份已导入，请在「已安装」中确认后开始恢复

en: {0} plugins from this backup are not installed
zh: 备份中有 {0} 个插件尚未安装

en: No themes in the catalog yet
First installs download the plugin and its dependencies — large plugins can take 1-3 minutes
zh: 首次安装需下载插件的依赖包，大型插件可能需 1-3 分钟

en: Taking longer than usual. A dependency that downloads or compiles can need a few minutes. Cancel and retry on another network if you cannot wait
zh: 比平常久。有依赖在下载或编译时，要等几分钟；等不及可以取消，换个网络再试

en: is now active. Switch any time in Settings → Plugin Market → Themes
zh: 已启用。可在「设置 → 插件市场 → 主题」中随时切换

en: is now off; it stopped working immediately

zh: 已安装，与当前 dsh 不兼容

en: Shared code for other plugins. No need to enable it.
zh: 供其他插件使用，无需启用。
已取消，部分更改已应用

en: Removed, but pnpm reported an error while finishing up (usually a locked file). Your settings are already in sync — no retry needed.
zh: 已卸载，但 pnpm 在收尾阶段报错（通常是文件被占用）；配置已同步，无需重试
在 GitHub 上查看仓库

en: Describe it in your own words. This replaces the author description.
zh: 用你自己的话描述这个插件，将代替作者简介显示

en: This plugin is marked as deprecated by the catalog; new users are advised against installing it.
zh: 该插件已被目录标记为废弃，不建议新用户安装。

en: {0}'s settings panel cannot read its config: it asks for "{1}", and no entry id in this environment has that name. Its own entry is "{2}", which is what the plugin's client should ask for — the mistake is in the plugin, and the market cannot change it.
zh: {0} 的设置面板读不到配置：它按「{1}」读取，而这个环境里没有这个名字的条目 id。它自己的条目是「{2}」，插件客户端应该改成读那个——这是插件自身的问题，市场无法代改。

en: {0} was removed after a failed update

The running DSH blocked the update, and the version it was replacing was already damaged. The market removed it from the profile so the next start does not fail. Its directory is untouched — quit DSH and install it again.
zh: DSH 正在运行时无法更新，而更新前的版本也已经损坏。为避免下次启动卡住，市场把它从 profile 里移除。插件目录还在原处，退出 DSH 后重新安装即可。

en: {0} was removed after an update was cancelled

The update was cancelled after the old version had been partly cleared. The market removed it from the profile so the next start does not fail. Its directory is untouched — install it again; if that fails, quit DSH first.
zh: 取消时，旧版本已被清掉一部分。为避免下次启动卡住，市场把它从 profile 里移除。插件目录还在原处，重新安装即可；若再次失败，先退出 DSH 再装。

en: No groups yet. Create one to begin.
No ungrouped plugin available to add
zh: 没有未分组的插件可加入

en: Adding to a group does not enable plugins
zh: 加入分组不会自动启用插件

en: A group holds one theme. Choosing one does not enable it. Replacing moves the previous theme out of the group.
zh: 一组只有一个主题。选择不会启用它，更换会把原来的主题移出该组。

en: Groups are for organization only and do not change enable state
zh: 分组仅用于整理，不会改变插件启用状态

en: Only the group name changes — members and enable state stay the same
zh: 只改分组名称，组内插件与启用状态不受影响
另有 {0} 条待确认信息
没有已满足的依赖条目

en: No plugin uses these directories and they do not stop DSH from starting: an interrupted update left them behind. Quit DSH, then delete them or reinstall the affected plugin.
zh: 这些目录不被任何插件使用，也不影响启动，是更新中断后留下的。退出 DSH 后可以删除，或重新安装对应的插件。
残缺的包目录（缺少 package.json）

en: Plugins whose settings read the wrong name
zh: 设置面板读不到配置的插件

en: A plugin panel reads its own config by ENTRY ID. A wrong name there reports nothing: the panel is blank and cannot save, and the plugin falls back to whatever default it hardcoded (a canvas panel shows a white screen). The name is wrong inside the plugin's own client bundle — the market cannot fix it, its author has to change one line.
zh: 插件面板按「条目 id」读自己的配置，写错名字不会报错，只会静默读不到值：面板空白、存不进去，插件会退回它写死的默认值（画布类插件因此白屏）。这是插件客户端里的名字写错了，市场改不了它，需要插件作者改一行代码。

en: it reads its config from "{0}", which is not an entry id
zh: 它按「{0}」读配置，但这不是任何条目 id

en: it declares no entry id of its own
zh: 它自己没有声明任何条目 id

en: This page checks for plugin conflicts, mismatched dependencies and wrong load order. Terms used:
zh: 本页检查插件冲突、依赖版本不匹配与加载顺序问题。常用术语：

en: bundle = one plugin package, applied in order
zh: bundle = 一个插件包，会按顺序叠加加载

en: entry = one item a plugin registers in the running composition
zh: 加载条目 = 插件在运行组合里注册的每一项

en: peer dependency = another package a plugin requires from the host
zh: 对等依赖 = 插件要求宿主环境提供的另一个包

en: shadowing = a plugin’s old copy covers the host’s newer one
zh: 遮蔽 = 插件自带的旧版包盖住了宿主的新版

en: invalid entry = config references something that does not exist
zh: 无效条目 = 配置里引用了不存在的东西

en: load order = the order plugins activate; the later one may override the earlier
zh: 加载顺序 = 插件被激活的先后，后加载者可能覆盖先加载者

en: Drag ⠿ to reorder. Changes are saved when you apply the order.
zh: 拖动 ⠿ 调整顺序，选择「应用顺序」后才会保存

en: before/after conflicts in the current order
zh: 当前顺序的 before/after 冲突
建议顺序（按 before/after 规则自动排序）：

en: Current order already satisfies every rule and plugin dependency — nothing to reorder
zh: 当前顺序已满足全部规则与插件依赖，无需调整

en: This order would change the composition: {0} override(s), {1} orphan(s), {2} duplicate(s)
zh: 该顺序会改变组合：{0} 处覆盖、{1} 个无效条目、{2} 个重复条目

en: Same-name plugins (informational only, not a conflict)
zh: 同名插件（仅供参考，不算冲突）

en: Hand the diagnostics to a new Agent session (copied to the clipboard; you decide whether to send)
zh: 将诊断问题交由新对话中的 Agent 修复（内容已复制到剪贴板，由你决定是否发送）

en: Please help me fix the plugin issues of DeepSeek Harness (profile: {0}). Diagnostics found:
zh: 请帮我修复 DeepSeek Harness 的插件问题（profile：{0}）。诊断发现如下：

en: Step 1 — identify yourself first. Before touching anything, determine whether the process you are running in IS the DeepSeek Harness process this profile belongs to (i.e. this diagnosed composition is the one you are running in right now). Check whether the cwd / $DSH_HOME / command line points at this profile, or whether you are running inside a deepseek-harness process. If you cannot tell, assume the answer is "yes" (the safe choice).
zh: 【第一步·先判断身份】开始前先判断：当前 Agent 所运行的进程，是否就是这个 profile 对应的 DeepSeek Harness 本机进程（即：诊断出的这套组合，就是你现在运行中的组合）？判断依据：当前工作目录 / $DSH_HOME / 进程命令行是否指向该 profile，或你是否运行在 deepseek-harness 进程内。若无法确定，一律按【是你】处理（更安全）。

en: If YES — you are this harness: never change the live composition, the harness or core packages in place (don't edit cordis.patch.yml, don't reorder/enable/disable bundles, don't install/remove/upgrade a plugin, don't reinstall deps, don't upgrade/restart dsh). Three steps: 1) read-only analysis only, change nothing; 2) produce apply.sh/.bat (this fix's changes) and rollback.sh/.bat (fully reverts it); both are safe to re-run — apply snapshots only when none exists yet and never overwrites an existing snapshot (an existing one means apply already ran, so roll back or confirm before re-running), while rollback restores from that snapshot, so a half-run apply can still be rolled back and repeated rollback is safe; 3) have me run apply in an external terminal and paste the output back to you. State the reason and wait for my confirmation at each step — never run these yourself.
zh: 【是 → 你就是这个 harness】严禁原地改动组合、harness 或核心包：不修改 cordis.patch.yml、不调整 bundle 顺序或启停、不安装/卸载/升级插件、不重新安装依赖、不升级或重启 dsh。三步：① 先只读分析，不改任何东西；② 给出 apply.sh/.bat（本次修复的改动）与 rollback.sh/.bat（完整撤销 apply）；两者都可重复执行——apply 只在没有快照时创建快照（不覆盖；已有快照说明 apply 跑过，先回滚或确认再重跑），rollback 从快照恢复，因此 apply 跑到一半失败也能回滚、重复回滚也安全；③ 由我在外部终端执行 apply，并将 stdout/stderr 回贴给你判断。每步先说明理由、等我确认；绝不自行执行。

en: If NO — you are a process outside the target harness: you may then consider reordering dsh.profile.bundles, disabling / enabling plugins, or adjusting cordis.patch.yml. Note: official bundles are fixed; state your plan before changing anything.
zh: 【否 → 保守执行】你要是判定自己并非运行在目标 harness 内（独立进程），才可考虑：修改 dsh.profile.bundles 顺序、停用/启用插件、调整 cordis.patch.yml。注意：官方 bundle 不可移动；动手前先说明计划。

en: Be conservative: only fix the clear errors listed above (boot failures / duplicate entries / risk-level dependency mismatches). Treat warnings and informational entries (e.g. optional or unconfirmed peer ranges) only when they relate to a clear error. Do not perform unnecessary upgrades or reordering; explain each change and wait for confirmation.
zh: 请保持保守：只修复上面列出的明确错误（启动失败/重复条目/风险级依赖不匹配）。警告和信息级问题（如可选依赖、未确认的依赖范围）仅在它们与明确错误相关时处理。不要做不必要的升级或重新排序；每项改动前说明理由并等待确认。

en: Fix prompt copied — paste it into a new conversation and send when ready
zh: 已复制修复说明，请粘贴到新对话中发送

en: Clipboard unavailable — copy the diagnostics below manually
zh: 无法访问剪贴板，请手动复制下面的诊断内容

en: community bundle load order conflicts with declared before/after rules
zh: 社区 bundle 加载顺序与插件声明的 before/after 规则冲突

en: No conflict, dependency or ordering issues found
zh: 未发现冲突、依赖或加载顺序问题

en: Save the current plugin order and disabled plugins as a preset and switch anytime; applying runs a trial start and creates a snapshot first.
zh: 把当前的插件顺序和已停用的插件保存为组合，随时切换；应用前会先试启动一次并自动创建快照。
重排 {0} 个插件的位置

en: Snapshots are taken automatically before applying changes; you can also create one manually and roll back anytime.
zh: 应用变更前会自动创建快照；也可手动创建，随时回滚到任意状态。

en: Restoring overwrites the current plugins and configuration from the snapshot; this cannot be undone (create a new snapshot first if unsure).
zh: 回滚会用快照覆盖当前的插件与配置，且不可撤销（可先创建新快照再回滚）。

en: This snapshot cannot be recovered after deletion.
zh: 删除后该快照将无法恢复。

en: The market itself cannot be disabled
A plugin lists packages that DSH already provides, so two copies may clash (declaration only — not confirmed):
zh: 插件把 DSH 自带的公共包列进了依赖，可能和 DSH 自己的版本互相干扰（仅依据声明，未确认）：

en: This restart never came up, and dsh has exited. Tick the plugins to enable at the next start; the ones this boot blamed are marked in red and left unticked.
zh: 本次重启没有成功，dsh 已经退出。勾选你希望下次启动时启用的插件；本次启动报错的插件已标红并取消勾选。

en: The log does not say why
zh: 日志里没有说明具体原因
dsh 的原始输出（结尾部分）

en: The plugins marked in red failed during this boot; unticking them disables them on the next start.
zh: 下面标红的插件在本次启动时报了错，取消勾选后下次启动不再启用它们。

en: The log named no plugin in particular; below is what can be adjusted, as it stands now.
zh: 日志没有指出具体插件，下面按启用状态列出可调整的插件。

en: Named by DSH but not switchable here:
zh: DSH 指出但本页无法开关的插件：

en: Restarting: this page reloads once dsh is up; if it fails again you come back here with the new error.
zh: 正在重启：dsh 启动后本页会刷新；若又失败，会带着新的报错回到这里。

en: The last choice was not saved in full, so nothing was restarted:
zh: 上次的选择没有全部保存，因此没有重启：

en: Timed out waiting for DeepSeek Harness to start. "Adjust plugins" can tell you whether one of them is what stops it.
zh: 等待 DeepSeek Harness 启动超时。可点「调整插件」，检查是否某个插件导致无法启动。

en: After the last failed start, DSH's recovery replaced your configuration with a default one. The previous {0} settings are still in the backup.
zh: 上次启动失败后，DSH 的恢复流程把配置换成了默认的。原来的 {0} 条还在备份里。

en: Restored {0} settings. Refresh the page to see them.
zh: 已恢复 {0} 条设置。刷新页面就能看到。

en: A snapshot is taken first, so you can roll this back.
zh: 恢复前会自动存快照，随时能退回。
